# v1.6.1 — Distinct theme UI overhaul

Each bundled theme (except **AMUD Default** and **Luxury Gold**) now has its own visual identity — typography, card chrome, topbar, buttons, and custom icon packs — not just a color swap.

## Themes

- **Manifest v4** — `assetBase` on jsDelivr; icons, wallpapers, and gallery previews load from `themes-assets/` on GitHub (lean `ui.tar.gz`)
- **`theme-engine.js`** — per-theme Google Fonts, CDN icon packs, wallpaper resolution; `data-theme-id` on dashboard/settings/login
- **35 redesigned themes** — unique UI profiles (gothic, CRT, brutalist, sakura, arcade, etc.)
- **Theme save fix** — nested forms in Settings no longer break **Save Settings**; default gallery preview uses Monstera wallpaper

## Upgrade

```bash
curl -sSL https://github.com/boubli/AMUD-Dashboard/releases/latest/download/update-amud.sh | bash
```

**Note:** Non-default themes need internet on first load for CDN icons/wallpapers. **Default** and **Luxury Gold** stay fully offline.
